page.overview:
Who is Aragog?

Aragog is a brick built Harry Potter animal figure first introduced in 2002.

Aragog was Hagrid's giant spider. He lived in a large cave in the Dark Forest outside Hogwarts. He had hundreds of acromantula children. His brothers and sisters are evil, but don't attack the school only because of him. In Harry Potter's second year, he and Ron Weasley meet Aragog and are almost killed by him and his family. During Harry's sixth year, Aragog dies, to Hagrid's dismay. Professor Horace Slughorn held an unofficial funeral for Aragog, and entitled him "King of the Acromantulas." Due to his death, his siblings seized the chance to attack the school during the Battle of Hogwarts, nearly killing Hagrid. The spiders eventually run away to the forest.
